tickets.title: Set up the repo and the tracker
tickets.description: Goal: git repo, .gitignore, .env, tracker copy (prefix DOCS, port 4712), AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md with the repo rules. Accept: tracker tests pass; tickets exist.
tickets.resolution: Done: git repo on main, .gitignore, empty .env, tracker copied from ../wallflower/tracker (prefix DOCS, port 4712, empty database), AGENTS.md with repo rules, CLAUDE.md imports it, 5 epics and 25 tickets. Verified: tracker tests 14 of 14 pass (cd tracker && npm test; jsdom comes from the root devDependencies).

tickets.title: Scaffold Starlight with 4 locales and the site style
tickets.description: Goal: Astro Starlight at base /moxie/docs with en (root), de, fr, nl, flag labels, sidebar, edit link, link validator, colours of volantislabs.dev. Accept: npm run build passes; switcher shows 4 languages.
tickets.resolution: Done: astro.config.mjs (site volantislabs.dev, base /moxie/docs, locales root en, de, fr, nl with flag labels, sidebar group helper with translated labels, edit link, link validator), src/content.config.ts with sourceHash, src/styles/custom.css with the colours of volantislabs.dev, Footer override with licence and video note in 4 languages, logo and favicon, welcome page in 4 languages. Verified: npm run build passes (5 pages, links valid, Pagefind, sitemap); headless Chrome screenshots of light and dark; the language select changes /de/ to /nl/.

tickets.title: Add the Worker config and test it with wrangler dev
tickets.description: Goal: wrangler.jsonc (name moxie-docs, assets base_path /moxie/docs, 2 routes). Accept: wrangler dev serves /moxie/docs/, redirects /moxie/docs, shows the docs 404 page. Fallback: nested outDir.
tickets.resolution: Done: wrangler.jsonc with assets.base_path /moxie/docs and 2 routes; npm run preview runs wrangler dev. Verified on the local Cloudflare runtime: /moxie/docs gives 307 to /moxie/docs/ (query string kept); /moxie/docs/, /de/, /fr/, /nl/ give 200; a wrong path below /moxie/docs/ gives the docs 404 page with status 404; favicon, sitemap and Pagefind files give 200. The nested outDir fallback is not necessary. Not verified until DOCS-6: zone_name with the build token.

tickets.title: Build the Video component
tickets.description: Goal: <Video feature=...> reads src/data/videos.json; empty id shows nothing; local poster; YouTube IFrame API loads only after a click; subtitles in the page language. Accept: no request to YouTube or Google before the click.
tickets.resolution: Done: src/components/Video.astro and src/data/videos.json (14 feature keys, all ids empty). Use: import Video from '~/components/Video.astro'. Verified in headless Chrome with a public test video: before the click the page makes requests to its own host only and has no iframe; after one click the player loads from www.youtube-nocookie.com with hl=de, cc_lang_pref=de, cc_load_policy=1 and the video plays (screenshot). An empty id renders nothing. An id with no poster file stops the build. Not verified: Safari. The test page, test id and test poster are removed.

tickets.title: Write the docs check script
tickets.description: Goal: scripts/check-docs.mjs. Fail on a missing translation or a stale sourceHash. Warn above 300 words. Accept: npm run check passes on the skeleton and fails on a changed English page.
tickets.resolution: Done: scripts/check-docs.mjs (npm run check). Verified: passes on the skeleton; exit 1 with 3 errors after a change of the English page; exit 1 when nl/index.mdx is missing; --stamp writes sourceHash; --hash prints the hash.

tickets.title: Tracker server accepts requests from other hosts and origins
tickets.description: Found by the commit security review. tracker/server.mjs listened on all interfaces and did not check Host or Origin. A web page could change or import tracker data (CSRF, DNS rebinding).
tickets.resolution: Fixed in tracker/server.mjs: listen on 127.0.0.1 only; 403 when Host is not localhost or 127.0.0.1 with the tracker port; 403 when an Origin header is not the tracker origin. Verified with curl: same host 200, wrong Host 403, wrong Origin POST 403, own Origin 200, socket on 127.0.0.1:4712; tracker tests 14 of 14 pass. The same code is in ../wallflower/tracker and is not changed there.
